common.prefixInfoA1: When you use the same seed phrase on multiple devices, they all share the same underlying cryptographic key (your User ID). To prevent conflicts between devices (like using the same transaction sequence numbers), each device needs a unique prefix (like laptop or phone). This splits your profile into separate, safe branches.
common.prefixInfoA2: Yes! The prefix is visible to your contacts (e.g., my-company:abc@...). Using a recognizable name (like your name or company) makes it extremely easy for partners to quickly identify and verify payments from you.
common.prefixInfoA3: Yes, it is optional. If you only use this profile on this single device, leave the field empty. This creates a standard "root account". You do not lose any functionality or security.
common.prefixInfoA4: A prefix is permanently tied to a profile once it is created. However, you can always create another profile (sub-account) on the same device using the same seed phrase but with a different prefix. You do not need to delete your old profile to do this.

common.prefixInfoSafety2: Using the exact same prefix (including leaving it blank) on two devices at the same time will cause sequence collisions. This will result in severe errors and inevitably damage your reputation in the network.

help.ads.long:
**What is this?**
Ads are time-limited posts on the notice board. You can choose between **Offer** (providing goods or help) and **Request** (seeking items or assistance).

**Duration & Renewal:**
Choose a duration of 30, 90, or 180 days. You can renew active ads with a single click or republish expired ones anytime.

**Distribution:**
Ads are shared cryptographically alongside your business card across your trusted network.
help.ads.short: Publish time-limited offers and requests with flexible duration on the notice board.
help.ads.title: Notice Board Ads
help.backup.long:
**What is this?**
Because your data resides solely on your device, regular backups are vital to protect your vouchers and identity.

**How does it work?**
You can configure automated, encrypted backups to a local folder or your sync service.

**What happens in an emergency?**
Using your seed phrase and backup file, you can restore your complete profile including all vouchers and contacts on a new device.
help.backup.short: Protect your profile and vouchers against device loss or damage with encrypted backups.
help.backup.title: Data Backup & Recovery
help.benutzerId.deepDive:
Decentralized Key Format (`did:key`):

• Technically derived from an Ed25519 asymmetric public key encoded as a `did:key` multicodec identifier.
• Cryptographic signatures prove authorship locally on any device without contacting an identity server.
help.benutzerId.long:
**What is this?**
Your User ID is your unique identity key in Human Money.

**Why does it matter?**
Contacts can verify reliably that a voucher or signature truly comes from you, letting you build real reputation over time.

**No central account needed:**
Your ID works without registering with any company or server.
help.benutzerId.short: Your User ID is your permanent digital address that allows contacts and exchange partners to identify you.
help.benutzerId.title: Your User ID
help.cardVisibility.long:
**What is this?**
You stay in full control of your personal data. For each field (such as phone, address, photo), choose its visibility:

• **Everyone:** Visible to anyone who receives your card.
• **My Contacts Only:** Given only to direct contacts and stripped automatically upon forwarding.
• **Nobody:** Remains private on your device.

**Honest boundary:**
"My Contacts Only" ensures compliant apps do not pass the field along. There is no technical barrier against a contact manually writing down details.
help.cardVisibility.short: Decide for every field on your card: Everyone, My Contacts Only, or Nobody.
help.cardVisibility.title: Field Visibility
help.conceptCommunity.long:
**What is this?**
A self-issued voucher works wonderfully among friends. For strangers, additional co-signers build trust: witnesses and guarantors.

**What is the difference?**
• **Witnesses:** Merely confirm your identity ("I really know this person").
• **Guarantors:** Create maximum commitment ("If the issuer fails to deliver, I stand in for the value").

**What does this mean for you?**
Voucher standards such as Minuto require guarantors for vouchers to become valid. In this way, the community self-organizes protection against unbacked promises.
help.conceptCommunity.short: Witnesses and guarantors make personal vouchers reliable even beyond your direct circle of friends.
help.conceptCommunity.title: Commitment Through Community
help.conceptFuture.long:
**What is this?**
Human Money is designed as an adaptable ecosystem scaling from private circles to entire regions and institutions.

**What possibilities exist?**
Communities can define their own voucher standards linked to labor time, physical goods, or existing currencies. Trust anchors and clearinghouses can certify standards.

**Resilient & self-sovereign:**
Even during power or internet outages, the system remains operational via local devices and offline transfers. No central authority can take away your agency.
help.conceptFuture.short: From neighborhood exchange to regional currencies – the flexible system scales with its users.
help.conceptFuture.title: Outlook & Future Potential
help.conceptParadigm.long:
**What is this?**
Human Money is a decentralized money system where people create value through personal promises of service. You need no banks, corporations, or central authorities to create reliable money.

**Why is it important?**
Conventional money today is mostly created as bank credit from debt. Human Money puts this on a human foundation: Your own skills and labor back the value of your vouchers.

**What happens in the background?**
Every voucher is an independent, cryptographically signed file. Payments work directly from device to device – private, self-sovereign, and without a global blockchain.
help.conceptParadigm.short: Human Money creates value from mutual promises of real people instead of central debt money.
help.conceptParadigm.title: The Human Money Paradigm
help.conceptPrivacy.long:
**What is this?**
Human Money deliberately avoids a global blockchain. There is no public ledger where all transactions worldwide are visible forever.

**Why is it important?**
Your financial transactions are nobody else's business. Vouchers are exchanged directly as protected files between you and your counterpart.

**How does it work offline?**
You can transfer vouchers even without an internet connection via QR code or local file transfer. Encrypted sync services only assist when you are not online at the same time.
help.conceptPrivacy.short: Your data and vouchers stay encrypted on your device – without central servers and without a global blockchain.
help.conceptPrivacy.title: Privacy & Offline Freedom
help.conflicts.deepDive:
Conflict Proofs (`.hmcproof`) & SST V4 Evidence:

• Contains both conflicting transaction records, deterministic fork point hash (`fork_point_prev_hash`), and optional cryptographic SST V4 identity attribution.
• Supports importing/exporting `.hmcproof` files and recording an audited local settlement override.
help.conflicts.long:
**What happened?**
A conflict appears when two conflicting transfers exist for the same voucher.

**Is my voucher still valid?**
If your own voucher was affected, it stays safely paused until settled; otherwise your vouchers stay unaffected.

**What should I do?**
Open the report to review who was involved, remove trust from unreliable contacts, or record a private settlement once clarified directly.
help.conflicts.short: A conflict occurs when the same voucher is spent multiple times – the culprit is cryptographically exposed.
help.conflicts.title: Conflicts & Double-Spending
help.connection.deepDive:
Zero-Knowledge Encrypted Drop Architecture:

• Communication uses bucket-padded XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted blobs stored under opaque slots.
• Polls leverage HTTP ETag / `If-None-Match` conditional checks and staggered class cooldowns to minimize bandwidth and hide metadata.
help.connection.long:
**What is a sync helper?**
When you and a friend aren’t online at the same moment, your app places encrypted packages in an exchange box so your friend can pick them up later.

**Total privacy:**
The server operator sees neither who is talking to whom nor what vouchers or messages are inside — everything stays locked end-to-end.
help.connection.short: A sync service synchronizes your encrypted data with contacts even when you are not online together.
help.connection.title: The Sync Service
help.deviceBinding.deepDive:
Hardware Keystore & Enclave Wrapping:

• Derives a hardware-bound wrapping key from platform keystore / TPM / enclave attributes.
• Always keep an up-to-date backup or recovery words, because motherboard failure invalidates hardware-bound secrets.
help.deviceBinding.long:
**What is this?**
Device binding locks your local profile file to this exact computer or phone so a copied file cannot be opened elsewhere.
help.deviceBinding.short: Binds your cryptographic keys to this hardware to prevent unauthorized copying.
help.deviceBinding.title: Device Binding & Protection
help.deviceLoss.long:
**Step by step:**
1. Choose **Restore** on the welcome screen of your new device.
2. Load your latest backup file or enter your 12 recovery words (or assemble shares from your recovery friends).
3. Confirm your password and review your vouchers and contacts.

If you had enabled automatic sync sealing earlier, the newest state syncs automatically.
help.deviceLoss.short: Install the app on your new device and restore your profile using your backup or recovery method.
help.deviceLoss.title: Lost or Broken Device — What Now?
help.emergencySheet.long:
**How to do it right:**
• Use pen and sturdy paper — never take a photo or screenshot.
• Check spelling and numbering from 1 to 12 carefully.
• Store it somewhere safe from fire, water, and curious eyes.

Anyone who finds those words can take over your identity — treat the sheet like spare keys and a deed combined.
help.emergencySheet.short: Write your 12 recovery words on paper in exact order and keep them offline in a safe spot.
help.emergencySheet.title: Storing Your Emergency Sheet Safely
help.faqCanIBeCheated.long:
**Double-layer protection:**
1. **Before accepting:** Look at the trust indicator and any voucher guarantors — avoid strangers offline when high amounts are involved.
2. **Online check & automatic proof:** Online payments block duplicate spends at checkout; offline double spends reveal the offender’s identity and strip their network reputation upon sync.
help.faqCanIBeCheated.short: Digital copies cannot be hidden for long, and community trust helps you spot reliable people early.
help.faqCanIBeCheated.title: Can Someone Cheat Me?
help.faqIsItCrypto.long:
**Human promises instead of coins:**
Human Money uses cryptography only like a tamper-proof digital signature — similar to signing a paper voucher.

• No speculative tokens or energy-wasting mining.
• Every voucher is backed directly by a real person’s promise of time, skills, or goods.
• Your payments stay strictly private between the people involved.
help.faqIsItCrypto.short: No. There is no blockchain, no mining, no speculation, and no global ledger.
help.faqIsItCrypto.title: Is This Bitcoin or Cryptocurrency?
help.faqSyncDown.long:
**Nothing is lost:**
A sync helper only forwards encrypted envelopes when people aren’t online together. Your actual vouchers live exclusively on your own device.

Even if a sync server shuts down completely, you keep 100% of your vouchers and can pay face-to-face or pick another server anytime.
help.faqSyncDown.short: Your vouchers remain safe on your device and you can always send or receive directly via QR or file.
help.faqSyncDown.title: What If My Sync Helper Is Offline?
help.faqWhatDoesItCost.long:
**Zero network fees:**
Sending, receiving, and creating vouchers costs nothing inside the app.

**Optional sync service:**
If you use an external sync helper to exchange vouchers when friends are offline, its operator sets whether that server is free, community-run, or paid.
help.faqWhatDoesItCost.short: The app is free open-source software with zero transaction fees.
help.faqWhatDoesItCost.title: What Does Human Money Cost?
help.guarantorVsRecommendation.long:
**Two completely different roles:**
• **Voucher Guarantor:** Signs directly on a specific voucher to stand behind its value if the issuer falls short.
• **Address-Book Trust Rating:** Reflects how well you personally know a contact. There is never any financial liability for other people’s vouchers just because you marked a friend as trusted.
help.guarantorVsRecommendation.short: Only voucher guarantors back a voucher’s value; address-book trust levels only share reputation hints.
help.guarantorVsRecommendation.title: Guarantor vs. Contact Recommendation
help.handover.deepDive:
Epoch Transfer & Active Lock Coordination:

• Increments the profile’s active epoch counter (`targetEpoch`) when reclaimed or transferred.
• Previous devices receiving the higher epoch enter read-only handover lock (`ForkLockOverlay`) until explicitly reclaimed.
help.handover.long:
**What is this?**
When moving your profile between devices without subaccounts, handover pauses spending on the old device so you cannot spend the same voucher twice by accident.
help.handover.short: Safely transfers active spending rights to a new device to prevent accidental double-use.
help.handover.title: Device Handover
help.l2Protection.deepDive:
Sync-Lock Committee Architecture:

• Lock Sets: Vouchers bind to an immutable initial committee manifest (1–5 servers, majority threshold Q) via the layer2_anchor field.
• Blind Write-Once Slots: Each transfer writes to a server-blinded write-once slot without revealing balances, amounts, or identities.
• Green-Rule Checkout: Automatic release requires at least Q server receipts AND at least N - Q + 1 receipts from independently trusted servers.
• Retention & Expiry: Servers commit to a retention quarter covering the voucher validity; locks purge automatically afterwards.
help.l2Protection.long:
Layer-2 protects online checkouts against instant double-spending.

• Sync-Lock servers store only blind cryptographic slot entries with no amounts, currencies, or identities.
• Lock committees consist of 1 to 5 independent servers; a quorum Q confirms transfers atomically.
• Locks purge automatically after the voucher retention quarter expires.
• Vouchers with N = 0 servers remain 100% offline-only (protected by Layer-1 math).
help.l2Protection.short: Online double-spending protection via blind Sync-Lock committees without accounts, balances, or global ledgers.
help.l2Protection.title: Layer-2 Online Protection
help.marketCard.long:
**What is this?**
Your business card is your digital storefront. It summarizes your profile and your permanent skills (e.g. craftsmanship, consulting, repair).

**Why is it important?**
With your business card, contacts in the address book and marketplace can see what you offer and how to reach you.

**Easy sharing:**
You can share your card via QR code, file, or automatically through your sync service with friends.
help.marketCard.short: Your digital business card presents you and your permanent skills to contacts and searchers.
help.marketCard.title: Business Card & Skills
help.marketplace.long:
**What is this?**
The marketplace connects you with people in your sphere. Here you can see who offers which skills and which ads are active.

**Why is it important?**
Instead of anonymous corporate platforms, the marketplace fosters direct local exchange based on mutual respect.

**How does it work?**
Browse offers and requests on the board, send inquiries with one click, or pay directly with vouchers.
help.marketplace.short: Discover people and ads in your personal circle – without middlemen and platform fees.
help.marketplace.title: The Local Marketplace
help.mnemonic.deepDive:
BIP39 Seed Derivation:

• The 12 (or 24) words encode checksummed entropy according to the standard BIP39 wordlist.
• Deterministic derivation produces your master Ed25519 identity key and profile encryption root keys.
help.mnemonic.long:
**What is this?**
These 12 or 24 words form the foundation of your decentralized identity and cryptographic keys.

**Why is it important?**
Because there is no central server, no customer support can reset your credentials. Whoever possesses these words controls the profile. If lost, recovery is impossible.

**What should I do?**
Write down the words carefully on paper and store them in a secure place. Never save them digitally or in photos!
help.mnemonic.short: The master key made of secret words that can restore your identity and profile at any time.
help.mnemonic.title: The Seed Phrase
help.multiDevice.long:
**Why coordination matters:**
Every payment creates a sequential signature chain. If two devices spend simultaneously without coordination, they conflict.

**Your two safe options:**
• **Switching back and forth (e.g., phone and laptop):** Use **Device Handover** so only one device holds the active spending right.
• **Paying from both at the same time:** Give each device its own **Subaccount prefix** in Expert mode.
help.multiDevice.short: Use either Device Handover for alternating devices or Subaccounts for parallel spending.
help.multiDevice.title: Using Your Profile on Multiple Devices
help.offlineProtection.deepDive:
Shared-Signature Traps (SST V4):

• Offline spend signatures deterministically share algebraic structure bound to the same voucher step.
• Two conflicting sibling spends solve the trap equation, exposing the offender’s `did:key` cryptographic identity link without requiring any central ledger.
help.offlineProtection.long:
**What is this?**
You can pay and accept vouchers anytime without internet — there is no central server checking beforehand.

**How honesty stays protected:**
If someone gives the exact same voucher to two different people offline, both receipts fit together like two halves of a puzzle when either person goes online next.

**Clear consequence:**
The offender is identified automatically and loses trust across their contacts.
help.offlineProtection.short: Payments work offline; mathematical traps permanently expose fraud upon the next network sync.
help.offlineProtection.title: Offline Protection & Honesty
help.offlineRisk.long:
**When you are online:**
Payments check a decentralized lock registry in a fraction of a second so a voucher cannot be spent twice.

**When you are offline:**
You can still accept vouchers smoothly without signal. Only accept larger offline amounts from people you know or trust well, because mathematical fraud detection triggers when one of the parties next syncs.
help.offlineRisk.short: Online checks catch duplicate spends before completion; offline payments rely on trust and automatic self-exposure.
help.offlineRisk.title: Offline Payments vs. Online Verification
help.passphrase.long:
**What is this?**
The passphrase is an optional secret word that extends your seed phrase (often called the 13th or 25th word).

**Why is it important?**
Even if someone discovers your physical paper with the seed phrase, they cannot access your profile without this passphrase.

**Caution:**
If you forget this passphrase, recovery is permanently impossible – even with the correct seed words.
help.passphrase.short: Additional secret protection for your seed phrase – like a personal extra word.
help.passphrase.title: Optional Passphrase
help.privacy.deepDive:
Stealth Signatures & Selective Self-Exposure:

• Stealth mode uses ephemeral transaction keys and unlinkable commitments so third-party recipients cannot track your identity across earlier hops.
• If a voucher is spent twice, mathematical trap linking deterministically reveals the real `did:key` identity.
help.privacy.long:
**What is this?**
When passing on a voucher, you can configure the privacy mode:

• **Stealth:** Anonymizes your signature in the chain, protecting against tracking by third parties. Your identity is mathematically exposed only in case of double-spending.
• **Public:** Your signature remains visible, providing open transparency in trusted communities.
help.privacy.short: Choose between stealth (private) and public visibility for your transfer signature.
help.privacy.title: Transfer Privacy
help.profile.long:
**What is this?**
A profile stores your vouchers, contacts, and settings securely encrypted on this specific device.

**Why is it important?**
Because there is no central cloud account, key ownership rests entirely with you. Your profile is protected with your personal password.

**Multiple profiles:**
You can create multiple profiles on a single device to keep professional and personal identities cleanly separated.
help.profile.short: Your local encrypted vault on this device storing keys, vouchers, and contacts.
help.profile.title: Local Profile
help.profileSeal.deepDive:
Encrypted Seal Format & Active Epoch Lock:

• Sealed with XChaCha20-Poly1305 using keys derived from your profile secret.
• Coordinates active spending epoch metadata alongside sync slot versioning so superseded devices enter soft handover lock cleanly.
help.profileSeal.long:
**How it helps:**
Your app periodically uploads an end-to-end encrypted snapshot of your profile so switching or restoring becomes nearly effortless.

Only devices holding your secret profile key can open it.
help.profileSeal.short: Keeps encrypted profile state synced smoothly to your configured sync space.
help.profileSeal.title: Profile Seal & Automatic Sync
help.sendReceive.long:
**Face-to-Face:**
Scan a QR code or use a direct nearby transfer when meeting in person.

**Over Distance:**
Send directly to a known contact when your sync helper is configured, or save a voucher transfer file to share via messenger or email.

**Safety First:**
Every handover checks and updates the voucher automatically so amounts and signatures always match.
help.sendReceive.short: Pass vouchers directly face-to-face via QR code, nearby transfer, file, or via a sync helper.
help.sendReceive.title: Sending & Receiving Vouchers
help.senderName.long:
**What is this?**
When sending a voucher, you can choose whether your name is visible to the recipient.

**Why is it useful?**
A legible name signals reliability and helps your counterpart immediately identify incoming payments.

**Privacy:**
Only the **direct recipient** of this transfer sees your name. Subsequent holders in the chain cannot view your real name.
help.senderName.short: Shows the direct recipient your name in their transaction history for easy identification.
help.senderName.title: Sender Name
help.settingsPrivacy.long:
**What is this?**
Configure the default privacy mode preselected when sending vouchers:

• **Stealth:** Maximum protection against tracking by third parties.
• **Public:** Transparent signature for close circles.
• **Interactive:** Choose individually on each transaction.
help.settingsPrivacy.short: Determine whether your transfer signature is stealth or public by default.
help.settingsPrivacy.title: Default Transfer Privacy
help.signatureRequest.long:
**What is this?**
Certain standards (such as Minuto) strictly require a set number of co-signatures (e.g. 2 guarantors) before a voucher can be used as payment.

**What should I do?**
When creating a new voucher, export the signature request and send it to trusted contacts. Once they have signed digitally, import the confirmation.
help.signatureRequest.short: Additional guarantees or witnesses are required for this voucher to become valid in the network.
help.signatureRequest.title: Signature Requests
help.socialRecovery.deepDive:
Shamir Secret Sharing (Threshold Cryptography):

• Your root entropy is split over GF(256) via Shamir Secret Sharing with an explicit k-of-n threshold (e.g., 2-of-3 or 3-of-5).
• Fewer than k shards reveal zero mathematical information about the secret.
• Each shard is bound to the guardian’s contact key or exported as a protected recovery share.
help.socialRecovery.long:
**Safe teamwork without single risk:**
Your app splits recovery into encrypted shares for trusted contacts (for example, any 2 out of 3 friends).

**Privacy guaranteed:**
A single friend cannot read anything on their own or spend your vouchers. Only when enough friends return their shares to you on a new device does your key reassemble.
help.socialRecovery.short: Split your recovery key across trusted contacts so a threshold of them can help you restore access.
help.socialRecovery.title: Recovery With Trusted Friends
help.subaccount.deepDive:
Deterministic Prefix & Sequence Isolation:

• Separates local transaction prefixes and counter namespaces while sharing the same identity reputation.
• Prevents concurrent devices from colliding on identical SST trap commitments or sequence epochs.
help.subaccount.long:
**What is this?**
A subaccount gives each of your devices (such as phone and laptop) its own separated transaction prefix so both can spend at the same time safely.
help.subaccount.short: Enables safe multi-device use of your identity through distinct device identifiers.
help.subaccount.title: Subaccounts & Device Prefixes
help.trustLevels.long:
**What do the tiers mean?**
• **Verified as human:** You know this person actually exists, but do not know them well. Confirms real existence without routing trust.
• **Acquaintance:** You know this person casually or from the neighborhood.
• **Friend:** You know this person well and value their reliability.
• **Close confidant:** You trust this person completely.

**Important rule:**
For tiers 1 to 3, you voluntarily back the person. If they cheat, it reflects on your own credibility. Formal guarantees exist only on vouchers themselves.
help.trustLevels.short: From "Verified as human" to "Close confidant", you define how much you trust your contacts.
help.trustLevels.title: The Four Trust Tiers
help.uiModes.long:
**Simple Mode (Default):**
Shows clearly worded actions for sending, receiving, backups, contacts, and marketplace without technical jargon.

**Expert Mode:**
Reveals technical IDs, custom backup options, merchant terminal tools, subaccounts, and diagnostic views.

**Where to switch:**
Use the toggle in the top header or in Settings whenever you need deeper control.
help.uiModes.short: Switch cleanly between everyday essentials and full technical details at any time.
help.uiModes.title: Simple & Expert Mode
help.visibilityReach.deepDive:
Selective Disclosure & Hop-Bounded Cryptographic Routing:

• **Reach levels:** Near = 1 Hop (direct contacts), Medium = 2 Hops, Far = 3 Hops.
• **128-bit CSPRNG Salts:** Each trust entry uses a fresh 128-bit salt inside a signed SD-JWT trust list so hashes cannot be correlated across sync partners.
• **Distance Redaction:** Entries exceeding your configured Hop bound are cryptographically redacted before forwarding while keeping your Ed25519 issuer signature intact.
• **Reciprocal Routing:** Peers share trust classes symmetrically according to mutual trust and configured Hop reach across QR, BLE, NFC, file, payment piggybacking, or zero-knowledge sync slots.
help.visibilityReach.long:
**Three clear presets:**
• **Near:** Direct contacts only.
• **Medium (Recommended):** Direct contacts and friends of friends.
• **Far:** Extended community network.

**Fair exchange & privacy:**
You receive broader signals from others in step with what you choose to share. Contacts marked at level 0 (“Confirmed Human”) as well as names and private notes never leave your device.
help.visibilityReach.short: Choose Near, Medium, or Far to control how widely your marketplace card and trust signals travel.
help.visibilityReach.title: Visibility & Network Reach
help.voucherBasics.long:
**What is this?**
A voucher is a digital promise for a specific service or good – such as an hour of neighborly help, craftsmanship, or regional produce.

**Why is it important?**
You do not have to wait for someone to give you conventional money. You can issue your own vouchers or receive and pass on vouchers from trusted people.

**What should I do?**
Create your first voucher or receive vouchers from contacts. You can share vouchers, pass them on as payment, or redeem them with the issuer at any time.
help.voucherBasics.short: Vouchers are digital service promises from real people that you can pass on flexibly.
help.voucherBasics.title: Vouchers Instead of Money
help.voucherCreator.deepDive:
Cryptographic Voucher Chain:

• Every voucher starts with a signed genesis record anchoring `creator_id` (`did:key`), unit, expiry (`valid_until`), and initial signatures inside an immutable `ProofChain`.
• Subsequent transfers append chained signatures without altering the original issuer commitment.
help.voucherCreator.long:
**What is this?**
The issuer is the person who originally created the voucher and promised the underlying service or goods.

**Why does it matter?**
Eventually, the voucher can be redeemed with its issuer.

**Checking reliability:**
Your app uses your contacts and shared trust ratings to show how well connected you are to the issuer or their guarantors.
help.voucherCreator.short: The person or organization that originally issued the voucher and is responsible for redemption.
help.voucherCreator.title: Voucher Creator
help.voucherExpiry.long:
**Why vouchers expire:**
Real human promises belong to real life — nobody can keep an open-ended promise forever without losing clarity.

**Circulation before expiry:**
Use or redeem vouchers with the issuer well before the expiry date shown on the card.
help.voucherExpiry.short: Every voucher carries a clear expiration date so promises stay active and manageable.

help.voucherMode.long:
**What is the difference?**
• **Test vouchers:** Have no real-world value. They are ideal for trying out app features risk-free with friends.
• **Real vouchers:** Represent a binding commitment for real services, goods, or time.

**Safety note:**
Always check whether a received voucher is in test or real mode. Test vouchers are clearly color-coded in the app.
help.voucherMode.short: Test vouchers are for risk-free learning; real vouchers represent binding obligations.
help.voucherMode.title: Voucher Mode
help.voucherSignatures.long:
**What is this?**
Vouchers can be digitally co-signed by multiple people with two distinct roles:

• **Witness:** Confirms the issuer's identity ("I know this person personally").
• **Guarantor:** Guarantees the redemption value if the issuer fails to deliver.

**Why is it important?**
Guarantees make vouchers dependable and tradable even for people outside the immediate friendship circle.
help.voucherSignatures.short: Signatures verify the issuer's identity (witness) or guarantee the value (guarantor).
help.voucherSignatures.title: Voucher Signatures
help.voucherStandards.long:
**What is a standard?**
A voucher standard specifies common rules — for instance, measuring value in minutes of work, setting a maximum validity period, or requiring two guarantors.

**Why use one?**
Shared rules make vouchers immediately recognizable and comparable across your neighborhood or region.
help.voucherStandards.short: Communities define shared templates for units, expiry, and required guarantors.
help.voucherStandards.title: Voucher Standards (Minuto, etc.)
help.voucherTrust.deepDive:
Subjective Web of Trust & Shared-Edge Factoring:

• Your local evaluator runs ego-centric path evaluation (Levels 1–3 weighted at 30% / 60% / 85%, Level 0 human-existence non-forwarding) plus voucher guarantor bridges (85%).
• **Shared-Edge Factoring** enforces bottleneck resistance so overlapping paths through the same intermediary cannot inflate trust scores.
• Any `KnownOffender` veto overrides all positive trust paths.
help.voucherTrust.long:
**What is this?**
The trust display shows how strongly your personal contacts connect to the issuer or guarantors of a voucher.

**Colors at a glance:**
• **Green / Strong:** Well connected through people you trust.
• **Neutral (Unknown):** Technically valid, but nobody you know links to it yet.
• **Red:** Warning about a proven conflict or revoked trust.
help.voucherTrust.short: Shows at a glance how reliably the creator or guarantor is backed through your personal contacts.
help.voucherTrust.title: Voucher Trust Rating
help.whichBackup.long:
**Two parts work together:**
• **Backup File (.hmcbackup):** Saves your current vouchers, contacts, and settings automatically.
• **Emergency Recovery Sheet (12 Words) or Social Recovery:** Restores your identity key even if your computer or folder is completely lost.

Keep both in separate safe places so neither theft nor hardware failure can lock you out.
help.whichBackup.short: Combine an automatic backup file for vouchers with an emergency recovery sheet or trusted friends.
help.whichBackup.title: Which Backup Do I Need?
help.wotNetwork.long:
**What is this?**
In Human Money, there is no central credit bureau and no global score. You decide locally who you trust.

**How does it work?**
When you receive payments, your app checks in the background whether trusted contacts connect you with the issuer.

**Responsibility without formal debt:**
In the web of trust, you do not formally guarantee debt. You voluntarily back this person: If they commit fraud, that slightly reflects back on you. Real names never leave your device.
help.wotNetwork.short: Your personal contacts help your app evaluate unfamiliar vouchers automatically and without a central server.
help.wotNetwork.title: Personal Web of Trust
